name: plan05-decision-write
objective: v2.3 plan 05: every author decision is WRITTEN, or it is put back. Deterministic (no model call): the runtime's own decision path is driven against the real manager, once with a save that lands and once with the evidence of a lost write. What this exists to catch is a guard whose signal cannot fire — the shape that shipped in the previous slice, where the put-back watched a `catch` around `saveMetadata` (which wraps its write in try/catch and never rejects, script.js:9412). jest cannot see that: the mock throws, the host does not. This scenario can, because it patches the manager's own `persist`. The real-LLM live variant is plan 05's gate recipe; this file must never stand in for it.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (const k of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((key) => key.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[k]; const row = { id: 'p05-decision-1', tier: 'facts', text: 'The ferryman owes the player a crossing', type: 'fact', importance: 3, expiration: 'permanent', entities: [], confidence: 1, activationTriggers: [], evidence: 'planted by plan05-decision-write', createdAt: 1, messageId: 0, recallCount: 0, pinned: true, provenance: { source: 'extractor', messageId: 0, boundary: 0, pass: 'shared-read', validity: 'source-removed' } }; const state = rt.extras.memory; rt.extras.memory = { ...state, entries: [...state.entries, row] }; const planted = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === row.id); if (planted?.provenance?.validity !== 'source-removed') throw new Error(`the planted row is not quarantined: ${JSON.stringify(planted?.provenance)}`); return { planted: row.id };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const applied = await rt.memoryActions.reconfirmMemoryEntry('p05-decision-1'); const after = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === 'p05-decision-1'); if (applied !== true) throw new Error(`a decision whose write LANDS was refused: the runtime answered ${String(applied)}`); if (after?.provenance?.validity !== 'live' || after?.provenance?.source !== 'author') throw new Error(`the reconfirmation did not reach the store: ${JSON.stringify(after?.provenance)}`); if (after?.provenance?.override?.from !== 'reconfirm') throw new Error(`the override is not the author's reconfirmation: ${JSON.stringify(after?.provenance?.override)}`); return { applied, validity: after.provenance.validity, source: after.provenance.source };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const original = rt.persist; rt.persist = async () => {}; rt.extras.saveHealth = { ...rt.extras.saveHealth, lastOutcome: 'unsaved' }; const key = 'fact:p05-decision-1:mara|condition'; const pair = { key, detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(), window: null, sides: [{ store: 'memory', id: 'p05-decision-1', label: 'The ferryman owes the player a crossing' }, { store: 'ledger', id: 'p05-ledger-1', label: 'Mara condition = injured' }] }; const ledgerRow = { id: 'p05-ledger-1', entity: 'Mara', entityType: 'character', field: 'condition', value: 'injured', createdAt: 1, messageId: 0 }; const state = rt.extras.memory; rt.extras.memory = { ...state, ledger: [...state.ledger, ledgerRow], conflicts: [...state.conflicts, pair] }; const outcome = await rt.memoryActions.resolveMemoryConflict(key, 'p05-decision-1'); const after = rt.extras.memory; const stillQueued = after.conflicts.some((candidate) => candidate.key === key); const kept = after.entries.find((entry) => entry.id === 'p05-decision-1'); const superseded = after.ledger.find((entry) => entry.id === 'p05-ledger-1'); rt.persist = original; delete rt.persist; rt.extras.saveHealth = { ...rt.extras.saveHealth, lastOutcome: null }; if (outcome !== false) throw new Error(`a decision whose write was LOST was reported as applied: the runtime answered ${String(outcome)}`); if (!stillQueued) throw new Error('the pair left the queue although the write was lost'); if (kept?.locked || kept?.supersededBy) throw new Error(`the kept side was written although the write was lost: ${JSON.stringify({ locked: kept?.locked, supersededBy: kept?.supersededBy })}`); if (superseded?.provenance?.override) throw new Error('the losing row was retired although the write was lost'); return { outcome, stillQueued, conflicts: after.conflicts.length };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const health = rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth; const notify = rt.extras.saveHealth.lastReason; for (const k of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((key) => key.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[k]; return { note: 'what this run does NOT prove', limits: [ 'that a REAL model would have written the planted row — extraction is not exercised at all here; this is the decision path only', 'that the read-back and the request observation work against a live save endpoint: the lost write is MODELLED by patching persist and the save evidence, so the host seam itself is not under test', 'that the drawer renders the refusal from a real click — the Storybook story covers that component, and this run asserts the store and the answer the drawer reads', 'anything about a real conflict DETECTED from the transcript: the pair is planted, so detection is not under test', 'the J6 pin/edit/quarantine variant and the J5.6 pinned-private-rollback variant, which need a real model and remain unrun' ], restoredHealth: { lastOutcome: rt.extras.saveHealth.lastOutcome, lastReasonWritten: notify, pending: health.pendingBoundary } };
